map_features.note: Approximate editorial locator points place a name in a recognizable region on the OSW equirectangular map. Points are neither observed cores nor endpoints or length measurements. Multi-basin family names have one point per basin and must be split into separate records before quantitative comparison.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: Northward eastern-Irminger-Sea reference branch along the western Reykjanes Ridge flank, from an OSW southern ridge gate at 56 N to an OSW pre-bifurcation gate near 65 N south of Denmark Strait. Excludes return flow toward Greenland, North Icelandic Irminger continuation, interior Irminger Gyre circuits, offshore eddies, opposite East Reykjanes Ridge Current and deep overflow currents. Gates are regional comparison choices, not established whole-current endpoints.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.
